title: 14 Roosevelt Ave (Z-26-12)
body:
14 Roosevelt Ave
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they must submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Dumart Development Consulting is proposing to build two residential buildings at 14 Roosevelt Ave in the form of two stacked townhouse buildings with 24 residential units, 20 parking spaces and 24 secured bicycle spaces.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
change the zoning from Residential One (R1) to Residential Eight (R8)
permit a minimum rear yard setback of 6.9 m from the required 7.5 m
permit a front yard setback of 5.8 m from the required 6.0 m
permit an interior lot line setback of 3.1 m from the required 7.5 m for Cluster
Developments
permit a minimum parking ratio of 0.75 spaces per
dwelling unit from the required 0.9 spaces
reduce the required visitor parking rate from 0.1 spaces
per unit to 0.083 visitor parking spaces per unit
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest building: 3.5 storeys
Number of units: 24
Unit sizes: 6 two-bedroom units, 6 one-bedroom units, 12 studios
Housing types: stacked townhouse
Parking
Parking: 20 (internal and external)
Bicycle parking: 24
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
